title: Instagram collabs: the fastest growth move almost nobody uses
description: A collab post puts you in front of someone else's audience for free. Here's how to pick the right partner, what to write in the DM, and how to turn one collab into lasting growth.
excerpt: One collab post lands in two feeds at once. It's the cheapest reach Instagram gives away.
content:
Instagram handed creators a feature that doubles the reach of a single post — and most accounts still ignore it. A collab post shows up in your followers' feed *and* your partner's, sharing likes and comments under one post.

## Picking the right partner

Don't chase the biggest account you can find. Look for someone within about 30% of your follower count whose audience would actually care about your content. A hairstylist and a makeup artist. A strength coach and a nutritionist. Two streetwear accounts in the same city.

Before you message, scroll their last ten posts. How many comments? If they have 20k followers and three comments per post, that audience is dead or badly bought.

## What to put in the DM

Short and specific. Not "hey, want to collab?" but: "Hey — I make content about X and we're a similar size. I've got an idea for a collab reel on Y: we each film our half, you post it, I push it in stories. Interested?"

A concrete idea roughly triples your reply rate. Hand your partner a plan, not homework.

## When it doesn't work

When you have 80 followers and no content. Partners collab for what you bring them. Before you start pitching, you need a profile that looks alive — consistent posts and real engagement.

That's exactly where [KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz) helps. Getting a starting base of followers and views means your profile reads as a partner worth working with. Content does the rest.

## Bottom line

This week, pick three accounts your size, send each a specific collab reel idea, and lock a date. One good collab beats a month of solo posting.
